importWizard.title: Import your account
importWizard.subtitle: A few short steps. Your data stays in this app's database, visible to you only.
importWizard.method.heading: How should we read your data?
importWizard.method.tip: Tip: both methods can be combined on one account. Import by UID for in-game stats, then add a full inventory file to get suggestions from pieces you already own.
importWizard.prepare.heading: Get your data ready
importWizard.uid.heading: Enter your UID
importWizard.uid.hint: 9 or 10 digits, shown in the corner of the game screen
importWizard.target.label: Import into
importWizard.target.auto: Automatically (the account with this UID, or a new one)
importWizard.target.new: A new account (or the one matching the file's UID)
importWizard.target.showcaseHint: Pick an account imported from a file to add the UID and in-game stats to it.
importWizard.target.fileHint: A full export replaces the account's {weapons} and {items}; characters are kept.
importWizard.file.heading: Upload the exported file
importWizard.file.paste: …or paste the JSON (if your exporter copies it to the clipboard)
importWizard.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB; that is not an exporter file.
importWizard.done.heading: Imported {name}
importWizard.done.unmatched: Not in the game catalog yet (kept under their own names): {names}
importGuide.genshin.showcase.title: Character Showcase (UID)
importGuide.genshin.showcase.summary: Reads the characters you show on your public in-game profile.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.pro1: Nothing to install, takes a minute
importGuide.genshin.showcase.pro2: Includes your in-game total stats (ER, CRIT, EM...)
importGuide.genshin.showcase.pro3: Repeat it with other characters to build up your roster
importGuide.genshin.showcase.con2: No unequipped artifacts, so no "better piece you own" suggestions
importGuide.genshin.file.title: Full inventory (exporter tool)
importGuide.genshin.file.summary: An inventory exporter on your PC saves every character, weapon and artifact as a GOOD file.
importGuide.genshin.file.pro1: All characters, weapons and artifacts at once
importGuide.genshin.file.pro2: Finds better artifacts you already own
importGuide.genshin.file.pro3: Talent levels and exact roll counts
importGuide.genshin.file.con1: Needs an exporter tool on a Windows PC
importGuide.genshin.file.con2: No in-game total stats (combine with a UID import)
importGuide.genshin.showcase.intro: Only what your public profile shows can be read, so first put the characters you want analyzed into your Character Showcase.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step1.title: Open your profile
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step1.body: In the game press Esc to open the Paimon menu, click your avatar at the top left and choose "Edit Profile".
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step2.title: Fill the Character Showcase
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step2.body: Open "Character Showcase" and pick up to 12 characters. Their weapons and artifacts are shown as they are equipped right now.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step2.tip: Start with the characters you want to improve; you can swap them later and import again.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step3.title: Turn on "Show Character Details"
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step3.body: Still in the profile settings, enable "Show Character Details". Without it only names and levels are public.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step4.title: Let the profile refresh
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step4.body: The public profile updates when you log out or after a few minutes. Entering and leaving your Serenitea Pot also refreshes it.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step5.title: Find your UID
importGuide.genshin.showcase.step5.body: Your UID is the 9 or 10 digit number in the bottom-right corner of the game screen and on your profile.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.trouble1: "Show Character Details is turned off": enable it in Edit Profile and wait a few minutes.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.trouble2: Old data: a public profile is cached for a few minutes; import again a bit later.
importGuide.genshin.showcase.trouble3: Characters from an earlier import stay in the app, so you can rotate your showcase and import several times.
importGuide.genshin.file.intro: An inventory exporter reads the data the game sends to your PC when you log in (or scans your inventory from screenshots) and saves it as a GOOD file, the common JSON format for Genshin Impact inventories. It does not change the game.
importGuide.genshin.file.fileHint: A .json file in the GOOD format
importGuide.genshin.file.step1.title: Get an inventory exporter
importGuide.genshin.file.step1.body: Use an exporter that saves the GOOD format. Download it from its official release page; most need no installation.
importGuide.genshin.file.step1.tip: Exporters that read the game data need administrator rights to capture the network traffic; screenshot scanners need English game text.
importGuide.genshin.file.step2.title: Start the exporter before the game
importGuide.genshin.file.step2.body: Run the exporter and start its capture before you enter the world.
importGuide.genshin.file.step3.title: Log into Genshin Impact
importGuide.genshin.file.step3.body: Start the game and click through the door into the world. Wait until the exporter shows that it has your characters, weapons and artifacts.
importGuide.genshin.file.step3.tip: Already in the game? Log out to the title screen and enter again while the exporter is capturing.
importGuide.genshin.file.step4.title: Export the GOOD file
importGuide.genshin.file.step4.body: Save the export as a file, or copy it to the clipboard and paste it in the next step.
importGuide.genshin.file.trouble1: Nothing captured: make sure the exporter was capturing before you entered the world, then relog.
importGuide.genshin.file.trouble2: After a game update the exporter may need an update too; check its release page.
importGuide.genshin.file.trouble3: Tools from other people are used at your own risk. An exporter only reads data; this app never asks for your game password.
